response.answer: Rapid pathogen detection trends include machine learning in point-of-care testing. Device engineering focuses on miniaturization and integration of sensors. Clinical validation emphasizes biomarker validation for drug performance. Regulation and biostatistics involve rigorous data analysis and compliance with health standards.
